storyboard.prompt: A single image divided into an exact 3x3 grid of 9 equal frames, each frame exactly one third of the width and height. No borders, no gutters, no numbers, no captions between frames. Frame 1 (top-left): ... Frame 9 (bottom-right): ... Global style: photorealistic, cinematic lighting, identical color grade in all 9 frames, the same exact product from the reference image in every frame. No people. No text, no captions, no logos, no watermarks.
